Patch Set 2:

(3 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Mostly good. Removing the LASSERTF is the right direction, and skipping the rollback when there was no old record also fixes a stale-qti_rec insert. A few comments inline. test_99 keeps fail_loc=0x2015 set, so the rollback insert always fails too and only the 'insert and restore' failure path gets run. A one-shot variant (fail_loc=0x80002015) that checks the old limits are still reported by `lfs quota` afterwards would cover the path where the rollback succeeds and the function now returns the error.

commit.subject: LU-20890 quota: don't panic on ENOSPC in lquota_disk_write
commit.message:
LU-20890 quota: don't panic on ENOSPC in lquota_disk_write

Replace ASSERTION in lquota_disk_write with CERROR. Even if we are
unable to insert a new or old record, the old one has already been
removed. At this step kernel panic can not restore anything and the
best we can do is to print an error with the ID needs to be repaired.
Below is an example of a panic in case of ENOSPC at the MDT. Note, the
same ASSERTION might be triggered at the OST side as well.

 LustreError: 105341:0:(lquota_disk.c:680:lquota_disk_write())
     ASSERTION( rc == 0 ) failed: failed to insert record in quota
     index [0x200000006:0x2020000:0x0]
 LustreError: 105341:0:(lquota_disk.c:680:lquota_disk_write()) LBUG
 ...
 Call Trace:
  dump_stack+0x41/0x60
  lbug_with_loc.cold.8+0x5/0x43 [libcfs]
  lquota_disk_write+0x9cf/0x9d0 [lquota]
  qmt_glb_write+0x166/0x400 [lquota]
  qmt_set_with_lqe+0x739/0xe60 [lquota]
  qmt_lqe_set_default+0x1f7/0x240 [lquota]
  qmt_lqe_read+0x2f7/0x350 [lquota]
  lqe_locate_find+0x32e/0x790 [lquota]
  qmt_pool_lqe_lookup_lqa+0xd0/0x260 [lquota]
  qmt_get+0x5f/0x410 [lquota]
  qmt_quotactl+0x81e/0xce0 [lquota]
  mdt_quotactl+0x7c3/0x9e0 [mdt]
  tgt_request_handle+0xc09/0x1b90 [ptlrpc]
  ptlrpc_server_handle_request+0x27f/0x1200 [ptlrpc]
  ptlrpc_main+0xb6f/0x13d0 [ptlrpc]
  kthread+0x134/0x150

Also replace LBUG in qmt_dqacq0. It can be hit on the same error
(ENOSPC, ENOMEM, EIO, etc.) when lquota_disk_write returns an error
and the slave index is rolled back.
